questions.prompt: Arrange these path differences from smallest to largest.
questions.explanation: Arrange by increasing multiples of λ.

questions.prompt: Light of 450 nm and L = 2 m. Arrange the slit separations so that fringe spacing goes from smallest to largest.
questions.explanation: Δy ∝ 1/d, so the largest slit separation gives the smallest spacing.

questions.prompt: Light of 450 nm and L = 1 m. Arrange the slit separations so that fringe spacing goes from smallest to largest.
questions.explanation: Δy ∝ 1/d, so the largest slit separation gives the smallest spacing.

questions.prompt: Arrange these units from largest to smallest.
questions.explanation: km > m > cm > mm > µm > nm.

questions.prompt: Light of 450 nm and L = 1 m. Arrange the slit separations so that fringe spacing goes from smallest to largest.
questions.explanation: Δy ∝ 1/d, so the largest slit separation gives the smallest spacing.

questions.prompt: Arrange these fringes from nearest to farthest from the central maximum (first dark fringe is m = 0).
questions.explanation: Bright: y = mΔy; dark: y = (m + ½)Δy.
